 Oblak set to become Atletico's second-highest appearance maker. EFE 
 Almost certainly in the starting line-up to face Barcelona tonight, Jan Oblak will etch his name deeper into Atletico de Madrid history as their outright second all-time appearance maker. 
 LIVE 
 Primera División. Round 12 
 Atlético 
 1 - 0 
 Barcelona 
 08 NOV 2026 
 When Sunday's top-of-the-table Primera Division showdown against Barcelona gets underway, Slovenian shot-stopper Jan Oblak will further cement his place in Atletico de Madrid folklore by becoming the second-highest appearance maker in the club's history .
 The goalkeeper currently sits level with Adelardo Rodriguez on 553 appearances. Taking his place between the posts against Barcelona will nudge him into second spot outright, trailing only his team-mate and club captain, Koke Resurreccion , who leads the way on 750 .
 Across his 553 outings in the 'Colchonero' shirt, Oblak has racked up 315 wins, 123 draws, and 115 defeats . Among the more intriguing footnotes to his tenure are 10 penalty saves, two own goals, and an assist for Sorloth against Club Brugge in the Champions League last February.
